title: console-tooling-standup-2026-06-02
content:
Date: 2026-06-02
Attendees: Sofia Martinez (owner), Liam Chen, Aisha Patel, Ethan Brooks, Rina Gupta
Notetaker: Sofia

1) Quick wins / shoutouts
- Aisha: dashboard filter performance fixes merged (PR #789). Loading spikes reduced ~35% on large orgs.
- Liam: rollout automation script for feature flags hit stable in staging. Saved 2 manual steps in canary deploys.

2) Updates by area
- UI (Aisha / Rina)
  - Working on accessibility pass for the Rollouts modal. Focus this week: keyboard focus order and aria labels. Estimated done by Fri (2026-06-05).
  - Addressing edge case where long route names overflow chips - proposed overflow menu UX (mock attached in Confluence link).
  - Blocker: intermittent snapshot mismatch when running storybook tests on mac-agent (file:// logs attached). Rina will open a small infra ticket if it recurs.

- Rollouts / Feature flags (Liam / Ethan)
  - Canary rollout v2: automation script now supports percent-based gradual ramp and auto-rollback on error-rate threshold (ENG-2345). Staging runs successful for two customers.
  - Need to finalize SR policy: what triggers immediate rollback vs. alert-only. Proposed thresholds: 5% error increase sustained 3 minutes -> alert; 10% immediate rollback. Action: Liam to write RFC and send to oncall-sre by Tue.
  - Integration test flakiness: intermittent race between evaluation and cache warm-up. Ethan investigating; suspects KV-cache TTL mismatch.

- Analytics & Observability (Sofia / Aisha)
  - Token-level cost breakdown dashboard: first pass is live in dev and showing expected variance across model families. Will add per-route breakdown next week.
  - Tracing: added span for rollout-evaluation path to help correlate latency spikes to routing decisions. Need to update sampling config in production (ops approval required).
  - Action: Sofia to get sign-off from platform-eng for increasing sampling from 0.1% -> 1% for rollout paths for 48h smoke window.

3) Blockers / Risks
- On-prem private deploy (customer X) reported false-positive rollbacks when model variants have slightly different tokenizer behavior. This causes metric mismatch. Assigned to Ethan + applied-ml for a brief investigation.
- Storybook mac-agent flakiness blocking UI regression gate for next release. If not resolved by Thu, we will temporarily flip the gate to run on linux-only agents and track manual checks.

4) Action items (owners + ETA)
- Liam: Draft RFC for SR rollback thresholds + notify oncall-sre. ETA: 2026-06-04.
- Ethan: Root-cause investigation for KV-cache TTL race in rollout tests; follow-up PR if needed. ETA: 2026-06-03.
- Rina: Open infra ticket for storybook mac-agent flakiness if it occurs again; include reproduction steps. ETA: immediate if repro.
- Sofia: Request platform-eng approval to bump tracing sampling for rollout-eval spans. ETA: 2026-06-03.
- Aisha: Finish Rollouts modal a11y pass and share updated mocks + test plan. ETA: 2026-06-05.

5) Decisions made
- Canary rollback thresholds provisional: 5% -> alert, 10% -> immediate rollback. Will be finalized in RFC.
- Temporary mitigation for storybook CI: run on linux-only if mac-agent flake blocks release; track manual visual QA.

6) Notes / Questions to bring up with PM (Rina / Sofia)
- PM: confirm priority of adding per-route cost breakdown vs. improving trace sampling. Both high value; team prefers to prioritize traces for immediate incident debugability.
- PM: confirm rollout UI changes scope - keep overflow menu out of MVP or include? Proposed: postpone overflow menu to post-MVP to avoid scope creep.

7) Misc / housekeeping
- Next standup: 2026-06-09 (weekly).
- Reminder: internal demo for cross-team rollouts next Wed (2026-06-09) @ 10:00 UTC - please have a short demo of canary behavior + analytics.

Unresolved / Notes to self:
- Follow up with applied-ml on tokenizer mismatch reproducer.
- Add test case in rollout-e2e for variant-tokenizer-consistency.

Attachments / links:
- Confluence: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/CONSOLE/pages/234567/Console+Rollouts
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/789
- Jira: ENG-2345, CONSOLE-112
